theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ψ : OuterMeasure (Eucl (m + 1))) (D : Set (Eucl (m + 1))), (∀ (c : Eucl (m + 1)) (τ : ℝ), ψ (ball c τ) = ⨆ τ' ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) τ, ψ (ball c τ')) → MeasurableSet D → ψ D = 0 → (volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) {c | c ∈ D ∧ 0 < limsup (fun t : ℝ => ψ (ball c t) / ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) ∧ limsup (fun t : ℝ => ψ (ball c t) / ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) < ⊤} = 0
